---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a building, mechanic, balance change or UI improvement
title: "[Idea] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like?**
Describe the feature or change.

**Why?**
What problem does it solve, or what would it make more fun?

**How might it work in game?**
Rough rules, numbers, where it would appear in the UI. Rough is fine.

**Anything else?**
Links to similar mechanics in other (original, not ripped) games, sketches, etc.
Please remember: Colonia only uses original art, sound and text.
